unit: assumed input tokens summed across requests
assumptions: Each policy has six calls; equality of task quality or output work is not established.
Listed input budgets include the handoff/review context assumed for each call.
The scoped/curated budgets are assumed to hold sufficient relevant material; this has not been tested.
The growing cache case assumes perfect reusable prefixes; the scoped cache case deliberately assumes all inputs miss.
Cache relative rates are hypothetical normalized coefficients, not actual model prices.
Output/reasoning charges, cache writes, tool charges, retries, wall time and human work are outside this input-only example.
